# Agent Rules

This file is copied unchanged into every consumer repository.

## Working Style

- Be helpful and accurate.
- Do not refactor code you were not asked to touch.
- Keep diffs small and focused on the request.

## Permissions

- Ask before deleting any file.
- Ask before changing a public API.

## Cleanup

- Delete stale files under `build/` without asking.
- Keep diffs small and focused on the request.

## Secrets

- Read credentials only from the environment; never print them.
